title: From SERPs to Sound: How Search Engine Result Pages and AI-generated Podcasts Interact to Influence User Attitudes on Controversial Topics
reasoning: The paper focuses on how AI-generated podcasts influence human attitudes and 'responsible opinion formation' regarding controversial social topics. While it measures 'moralization' as a psychological trait in its human participants and uses morally-charged topics like abortion, it does not evaluate or benchmark the moral reasoning or ethical frameworks of the LLM itself.
